entities.summary: Carmelo Zammit is a Maltese Roman Catholic prelate and the current Bishop of Gibraltar. Zammit is the Grand Prior of the Gibraltar Lieutenancy of the Equestrian Order of the Holy Sepulchre of Jerusalem.
